fusions.name: Opening Vein
fusions.desc: A downward chop that deals 14 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Red Harvest
fusions.desc: Swings the axe in a full circle, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Battle Flush
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Butcher's Rhythm
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 4 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
